name: Pressure / force response [Pa/N]
description: Complex P/F at the observation point, Pa/N. Columns 0 and 1 preserve real and imaginary components; 1 N peak force.

name: RMS pressure [Pa]
description: Observation-point RMS pressure. Recorded amplitudes are peak phasors, so RMS is amplitude / sqrt(2).

name: Sound pressure level [dB]
description: SPL in dB relative to 20 microPa RMS, computed explicitly from the peak pressure phasor; zero pressure is undefined.
